elements.content: Grammar focus: Advanced Passive & Causative Constructions.

Core Rule: Use Have / Get + Object + Past Participle for causative arrangements, or Modal Perfect Passives (must have been + V3) for past logical necessity.

Causative Have — Have + Object + Past Participle: The firm had its accounts audited by an external agency.
Modal Perfect Passive — Modal + have been + V3: The document must have been altered prior to submission.
Double Passive — Passive Verb + Passive Infinitive: The decree was ordered to be published .
Guided practice: choose the correct option.
1. Which sentence correctly expresses a causative arrangement?
options: The CEO had the report reviewed by legal counsel.
The CEO reviewed had the report by legal counsel.
